# Hydrogen Storage Tank (H2StorageTank)

> **Class**: `H2StorageTank` | **Module**: `energysim.models.hydrogen` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

## Overview

Pressurized hydrogen storage tank (single-node, linear compressibility Z = 1 + 0.0006 p[bar]).

The stored mass is the state; the reported pressure is always derived from the mass
(p V = Z n R T), so mass and pressure are consistent. Capacity is the mass at
``p_max_bar``: inflow beyond it is rejected (``m_dot_rejected_kg_hr``) and withdrawals
beyond the available mass are not delivered (``m_dot_unserved_kg_hr``). Mass is never
negative and pressure never exceeds ``p_max_bar``. Per step (kg/h):

    m_in - m_out - m_rejected + m_unserved == d(mass)/dt

``p_min_bar`` is only used to define SoC (it is not a withdrawal limit). A step with
``dt == 0`` leaves the mass unchanged; rejected / unserved then report the flow that
could not be handled given the current fill level.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'H2Storage'` | - | Unique component name identifier |
| `volume_m3` | `float` | `50.0` | m3 | Internal geometrical tank volume |
| `p_max_bar` | `float` | `350.0` | bar | Maximum allowable working pressure (MAWP) |
| `p_min_bar` | `float` | `20.0` | bar | Minimum residual suction pressure |
| `p_init_bar` | `float` | `150.0` | bar | Initial storage tank pressure |
| `t_gas_c` | `float` | `20.0` | degC | - |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |

## Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `m_dot_in_kg_hr` | kg/h | Inflow mass flow rate entering the tank (from electrolyzer/compressor) |
| `m_dot_out_kg_hr` | kg/h | Outflow mass flow rate dispatched to industrial loads or fuel cells |

## Outputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pressure_bar` | bar | Current internal tank pressure |
| `mass_stored_kg` | kg | Total mass of hydrogen currently stored in the vessel |
| `SoC` | 1 | Fill level between p_min_bar (0) and p_max_bar (1) |
| `m_dot_rejected_kg_hr` | kg/h | - |
| `m_dot_unserved_kg_hr` | kg/h | - |

## Validity and notes

Validity: single-node, isothermal tank (gas temperature fixed at t_gas_c) with the linear
compressibility Z = 1 + 0.0006 p[bar]; intended for pressures up to about 350 bar at roughly ambient
temperature; no thermal effects of filling or discharging.

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import H2StorageTank

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('h2storagetank', model=H2StorageTank(), outputs=['pressure_bar', 'mass_stored_kg', 'SoC'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['h2storagetank'].tail(2))
```
